decisions.story_title: 9300+ Active AWS Access Keys Exposed Publicly, Hundreds With Root Access
decisions.reason: Truffle Security tracked 9,300+ valid AWS keys exposed in public repos, Git history, and datasets. 817 linked to companies, 526 root keys, 242 with AdministratorAccess. 768 keys give full account control. Concrete finding with real enterprise risk.
Sen. Wyden and Rep. Casar requesting GAO review of federal government hacking/spyware use. Legislative/policy action, not a security incident or vulnerability.
Microsoft blaming RGB peripherals for August Windows updates gaming issues. Update to existing story already covered by the mechanical merge.
SecurityWeek weekly roundup with just headlines. Zombie Card is covered by its own event (mf:161054). No independent substance.
North Korean APT Kimsuky distributing malware disguised as ROK reserve military training notices. Real threat actor campaign with operational targeting.
Mozilla advisory covering Firefox 154, ESR 115.39, and Thunderbird. Product advisory with substance.
Italian CERT-AGID weekly campaign digest. Summary of 132 campaigns across Italy. Generic regional weekly, not a specific incident.
Novel AI safety bypass technique. Encrypted prompts defeating guardrails in Grok and Gemini is a real safety concern.
Phishing kit that uses passkeys to persist access after password resets. Novel technique, significant for enterprise defenders.
University of Massachusetts Amherst research showing expired Visa contactless cards can be reactivated via expiration date tampering. Concrete payment security finding.
Apple security advisory covering Safari, iOS 18.7.10, and macOS 26.6.2. Product advisory with substance.
Picus vendor report on BFSI sector metrics. Marketing content dressed as research. Not a security event.
